scene: The cart rolls to a multi-level transit terminal overlooking new horizons.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of a bustling terminal platform. Far left, a solar junk bobs beside a wooden dock. Left of centre, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man steps out of his cargo cart with his ukulele. Up high centre, a round cable pod hovers on cables. Far right, a sleek pink bullet train awaits passengers.
shown: a sleek junk with glowing green solar sails moored at the pier, far left
a glass cable pod swinging gently from an overhead line, up high centre
a pink high-speed bullet train waiting at a platform with open doors, far right
